description: Presentations on Automotive Hacks at DEF CON 23 covers connected vehicle security, remote cellular exploitation, CAN bus injection, and wireless key fob replay attacks.

talks.title: How to Hack a Tesla Model S
talks.teaser: Marc Rogers and Kevin Mahaffey reveal multiple vulnerabilities in the Tesla Model S, demonstrating physical and software chain exploits to control vehicle systems.

talks.title: Drive It Like You Hacked It: New Attacks and Tools to Wirelessly Steal Cars
talks.teaser: Samy Kamkar introduces RollJam and other low-cost hardware devices that intercept rolling-code wireless key fobs to remotely unlock and access vehicles.

talks.title: Remote Exploitation of an Unaltered Passenger Vehicle
talks.teaser: Charlie Miller and Chris Valasek detail their groundbreaking remote exploit of a Jeep Cherokee over cellular networks to inject CAN bus commands and control steering and brakes.
